query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, he chased a squirrel all the way across the park and even knocked over a kid's bubble machine, I felt so bad I ended up buying the family a new pack of bubble solution to apologize. Then on the way home I stopped at the coffee shop and they gave me the wrong drink, I ordered an iced oat milk latte but got a hot caramel macchiato instead, it was way too sweet for my taste. Oh right, I actually reached out because I need to return an item from my delivered order #W4689314, the item I want to return is 5996159312, and I'd like the refund to go back to my credit_card_8105988 please.
